correctness.rationale: The forbidden odd-corner simplex dissection yields vol(H_d)=1-a_d, and symmetry plus Dirichlet simplex moments yields covariance s_d^2 I_d with s_d^2=1/12-a_d b_d/[6(1-a_d)]. This gives exact L^2 formula for all d>=3. The strict global minimum at d=5 follows from rational threshold t=13/160 separating d=3,4,5,6, and increasing variance s_d^2 from d>=5 plus s_7^2>t and vol<1 for every d>=7. Independently recomputed low-dimensional exact ratios and numeric profile; finite check was not used for all-d claim.

originality.rationale: An October 25 published Resultary theorem already proves the same full-dimensional parity-halfcube volume/covariance, exact all-dimensional isotropic constant, cube-sign transition, and factorial gap, after affine x↦(x+1)/2. Its 12L^2=(1-3 a m)/(1-a)^(1+2/d) is exactly the candidate 12L^2=(1-(1+2b)a)/(1-a)^(1+2/d), since 3m=1+2b. The remaining dimension-five optimization is a short inequality corollary of the previously complete exact profile rather than a new invariant; no distinct independent family or result beyond that profile survives.
residual_risks: Possible separate appreciation of the dimension-five extremizer as a nontrivial new corollary; rejection is based on the earlier exact all-d profile and straightforward interval comparison, not a correctness objection.
